subject.title: chore(deps): bump the actions group across 1 directory with 14 updates

question: After the setup-go guard is repaired and the branch is refreshed, should this grouped set of executable action revisions be approved under the protected security review path?
rationale: The diff updates third-party code executed with token, scanning, registry, release, and agent privileges, and the protected security label requires explicit maintainer handling even though upstream provenance review was clean.

options.title: Approve after guard repair
options.body: Keep the grouped update, require the one-line guard fix and final exact-head checks, then approve the reviewed pins together.

options.title: Split sensitive action families
options.body: Separate token, CodeQL, publishing, and Codex action updates if maintainers want smaller security review units.

recommendation.title: Approve after guard repair
recommendation.body: Keep the grouped update, require the one-line guard fix and final exact-head checks, then approve the reviewed pins together.

likelyOwner.reason: This contributor introduced the canonical pin guards and has the strongest recent history on the affected workflow-validation surface.
